cardBody: Import past sessions from the coding agents installed on this machine, or from exported session files.
description: Bring your command-line coding-agent histories into Cognia as continuable conversations.
doneBody: Added {sessions, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} with {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
emptyHint: Nothing was found on disk. Try choosing session files manually.

fidelityHint.contextual: A new session is seeded with a replay of the transcript.
fidelityHint.native-exact: The runtime resumes this session exactly as its own.
fidelityHint.structured: Text and tool history carry over; runtime-private state does not.
fidelityHint.summary-only: Only a summary of the conversation carries over.
fidelityHint.unsupported: This direction is not supported for this source.

fidelityReport.lossCount: {count, plural, one {# item was not carried over} other {# items were not carried over}}
fidelityReport.nativeResumeCandidate: Native resume candidate via {preset}; availability is verified at resume time.
fidelityReport.readOnlyMirror: Read-only mirror; continue with a Cognia model.
fidelityReport.rebuiltHint: This record was rebuilt from trusted artifacts — it is provenance-marked and does not claim to be the original transcript.
fidelityReport.reverseDormant: Writing this history back out as a new session in the original agent is defined ({fidelity}) but not yet available in Cognia.
fidelityReport.title: Conversion fidelity

liveSyncHint: Keep watching these agents and import new sessions automatically. A session you continue in Cognia is frozen and never overwritten.
pickerOnly: {sources} keeps its history inside each repository, so a scan can't find it — choose the file yourself.
title: Import agent sessions
unrecognized: These files weren't recognized as a supported agent session.
webHint: Auto-scan and live sync are desktop-only. On iOS and the web, choose exported session files manually.
